recommendations.suggested_paraphrase: Jena describes seed news circulating at weekly markets and village gatherings, where priestesses asked who still grew varieties they were seeking. The search depended on conversation as well as the journey to collect seed.
recommendations.value: One concrete social detail beyond the existing exchange ratio; shows how the network worked without adding totals or invented encounters.
recommendations.locator: An intricate ritual, paragraphs after the Jangojodi and Sagadi examples
recommendations.limits: Reported in July 2015; do not turn it into a rule for every gathering or a current programme. Dasara's recalled counts are not a measured historical inventory.

recommendations.location: Keeping a collection alive, existing Bijun Parab paragraph
recommendations.suggested_paraphrase: Prasad describes women cleaning seed and making baskets before bringing it to the priestess. Kumtadi Sikoka of Hundijali explained the prayer as seeking the deities' favour before sowing.
recommendations.value: Develop the existing brief ritual reference through preparation and a named explanation. Replace the generic sentence rather than adding a separate ritual catalogue.
recommendations.locator: A bejuni's prayer, final two paragraphs and Hundijali group photograph caption
recommendations.limits: A dated reported practice, not a universal ritual or present festival calendar. The account identifies Kumtadi but does not date this particular performance. Do not attach all described actions to Sanyasi Takri simply because the caption identifies his messenger role.

source_distinctions: IPS describes grain returned at twice the seed quantity; Mongabay says double the seeds. Keep the existing repayment passage explicitly attributed to IPS instead of combining wording into a universal seed-loan rule.
Gatri's existing display of seeds is sufficient; no need to reproduce the long crop list or assert verified varietal identities.
Storage treatments described by Mongabay are not controlled evidence of pest prevention; avoid turning them into instructions or efficacy claims.
No evidence here of a named elder teaching a named child; do not invent an intergenerational scene.
These reopened reports do not supply a current inventory, programme evaluation or general climate-resilience outcome.
